children: Emaar Hospitality Group has opened Vida Aljada, marking the Vida Hotels & Resorts brand’s debut in Sharjah and adding a five-star lifestyle destination to Aljada, the mixed-use development by Arada.
The opening expands Emaar Hospitality Group’s lifestyle portfolio and introduces Vida’s contemporary hospitality concept to a new emirate.
A ribbon-cutting ceremony was attended by senior representatives from Emaar Hospitality Group and Arada, as well as guests, partners, media and industry stakeholders.
Located in the heart of Aljada, Vida Aljada offers convenient access to Sharjah’s cultural, educational and business districts.
The hotel is three minutes from University City and Sharjah Airport Free Zone, and about 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport and Sharjah Corniche.
The property is designed as a hub for accommodation, dining, wellness, business and social activities, combining contemporary design with flexible spaces for leisure and business travelers.

Hakan Keskin, Head of Hospitality at Emaar Hospitality Group, said: “The opening of Vida Aljada represents an important milestone for Emaar Hospitality Group as we bring the Vida brand to Sharjah for the first time. We are pleased to introduce a hotel that reflects the character of Vida while responding to the evolving needs of the emirate. With its focus on contemporary design, dining, wellbeing and flexible spaces for business and leisure, Vida Aljada brings together the different ways our guests live, work and connect today.”
Vida Aljada features 175 rooms and suites, ranging from Deluxe King and Twin rooms to Premier Suites and a 305-square-metre Penthouse Suite.
The property also includes one-, two- and three-bedroom serviced apartments for extended stays, alongside one-, two- and three-bedroom residences aimed at longer-term living.
Dining, wellness, family and social spaces complement the accommodation, giving guests flexibility to tailor their stay
